tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page and scroll-view background behind every glass layer. Warm neutral, never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: canvas-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque content cards and message bubbles that sit in the content layer (not glass).

tokens.name: canvas-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks and inset regions inside the content layer.

tokens.name: glass-thin
tokens.usage: Thinnest material: icon-only controls and chips floating over content. Never put body text on it.

tokens.name: glass-regular
tokens.usage: Default material for toolbars, tab bars, the composer and menus. Holds `label` text at any size.

tokens.name: glass-thick
tokens.usage: Sheets, grouped lists and popovers that carry `label-secondary` text or dense content.

tokens.name: glass-smoke
tokens.usage: Smoked tint for controls floating over photos or video in both themes; pair with `label-on-smoke`.

tokens.name: glass-fallback
tokens.usage: Opaque stand-in for every glass material when the viewer asks for reduced transparency.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 0.5px rim on every glass shape — the light-catching edge that separates glass from content.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Selected-item lozenge inside a glass control (tab bar, segmented control thumb in dark).

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on `canvas`, `canvas-raised`, `glass-regular` and `glass-thick`.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, metadata and placeholder text on `canvas`, `canvas-raised` and `glass-thick` (not on `glass-thin`).

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs and decorative marks only — below 4.5:1, never for readable text.

tokens.name: label-on-smoke
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `glass-smoke` and on `accent` fills.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and toolbar groups.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Track of switches and segmented controls, quiet button fills inside glass.

tokens.name: system-blue
tokens.usage: Apple accent: tints, icons, selected states, decorative fills. White text on it is under 4.5:1 — use `accent` for filled buttons.

tokens.name: system-green
tokens.usage: Apple accent: switch-on track, success icons and fills. Not for text.

tokens.name: system-orange
tokens.usage: Apple accent: warm highlights, icon tiles. Dark glyphs only on it.

tokens.name: system-red
tokens.usage: Apple accent: destructive icons and badges. Text uses `danger-text`.

tokens.name: system-yellow
tokens.usage: Apple accent: icon tiles, starred states. Dark glyphs only on it.

tokens.name: system-teal
tokens.usage: Apple accent: icon tiles, secondary data series.

tokens.name: system-mint
tokens.usage: Apple accent: icon tiles, secondary data series.

tokens.name: system-indigo
tokens.usage: Apple accent: icon tiles. Do not pair with blue in gradients.

tokens.name: system-pink
tokens.usage: Apple accent: icon tiles, favourites.

tokens.name: system-brown
tokens.usage: Apple accent: icon tiles; warm neutral data series.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Filled primary buttons, send button, switch focus. Deepened system blue so `label-on-smoke` (white) clears 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and plain-button labels on `canvas`, `canvas-raised` and `glass-thick`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted buttons and selected rows; label it with `accent-text`.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success copy on canvas and thick glass; always beside a checkmark or word.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning copy on canvas and thick glass; always beside an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Destructive button labels and error copy on canvas and thick glass.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Filled destructive buttons and count badges, with `label-on-smoke` (white) text — 5.6:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every surface.

tokens.name: smoke-block
tokens.usage: Solid smoked-glass ink for illustration blocks and the cover; never a text ground.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map ground.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Map streets.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Map rivers and sea.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Map parks.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims and (with blur-thin) blurs the screen behind an open bloom menu.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the passive top zone; they scroll away with content. Drops to `title-3` at short (landscape) heights.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Pane titles on tablet and desktop; the screen title at short (landscape) heights.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Bottom-bar titles, button labels, list-row titles that need emphasis.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text, message bodies, list-row titles.
styles.sample: Frosted layers float above content and blur what passes beneath.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; hairline nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a glass toolbar; inner padding of the composer around its buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row vertical padding; gap between stacked glass controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins on phone; card padding; list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; screen side margins on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped lists and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above large titles and between major regions.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Icon tiles in list rows, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented-control thumb, small chips, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, opaque message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped lists and content cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The composer and floating glass panels.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of sheets — concentric with the device corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tab bars, badges, switches: every control is a capsule or a circle.

shadow.note: Each glass shadow pairs a soft drop with an inset top highlight — the specular edge of the material.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass: tab bar, composer, toolbars, buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers that rise over the whole screen.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch knob and segmented-control thumb.

material.note: Backdrop-filter strengths. Always write both -webkit-backdrop-filter and backdrop-filter.

tokens.name: blur-thin
tokens.usage: With `glass-thin`.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: With `glass-regular` and `glass-smoke`.

tokens.name: blur-thick
tokens.usage: With `glass-thick`.

tokens.name: saturate-glass
tokens.usage: Saturation boost applied with every blur so colour behind glass glows rather than greys out.

layout.note: Size classes and the reach zone. Breakpoints are measured on the screen's (or pane's) own width; CSS container queries cannot read variables, so bundle.css repeats these numbers — change both together.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: Compact → Medium. Medium covers foldables opened flat, small tablets in portrait and large phones in landscape: one column, centred.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Medium → Expanded. Tablets and narrow desktop windows: an aside pane appears beside the main pane, each with its own bottom dock.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: Expanded → Large. Desktop: wider aside, main content capped at `content-max` and centred.

tokens.name: bp-short
tokens.usage: Height below which a screen is 'short' (phones in landscape): the title shrinks, the tab bar drops its labels, the dock tightens.

tokens.name: reach-line
tokens.usage: Fixed interactive chrome lives below this line of the screen's height, always. Above it: passive titles and scrolling content only.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum reading width of the main pane's content on Medium and up.

tokens.name: dock-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the bottom dock (composer, bottom bar) on Medium and up; the dock centres in its pane.

tokens.name: aside-width
tokens.usage: Aside pane width on Expanded; 380px on Large.

tokens.name: dock-clearance
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of every scroll view so the last item can rise clear of the dock.
